title: Is Airport USB Charging Really Dangerous?
topic: The FBI and FCC warned about 'juice jacking', but the FCC says it knows of no confirmed real case; it's possible in labs. A charge-only cable or your own plug removes the risk.

whyCare: Sceptical take on a scary claim on the busiest travel day; competitors repeat the scare.
